Fix real build failures or key regressions. Record unavailable native/manual checks honestly; source inspection, Linux shims and previous-release observations cannot establish current Windows UI acceptance. reviewOnly: This file records human authorization and source-review scope. It is not a successful Windows build, a test result, a model semantic verdict, a completed release or proof of artifact identity.

releaseProductionBoundary.windowsValidation: Full actual Windows App/XAML build and affected-path TRX on the exact PR checkout, with authenticated successful run metadata and identical tested/final-main source tree required.
releaseProductionBoundary.packaging: Build packages from the final main commit once after reusing the successful same-tree PR validation; keep the exact embedded CUDA App binding and immutable published bytes. Match only the current DropSpace.App PackageVersion identity when collecting the already-built main MSIX/AppX, excluding SDK dependencies and stale versions; zero or multiple matches fail closed.
releaseProductionBoundary.languageAssetReuse: Reuse verified already-bundled lid.176.bin bytes from cache/PR evidence or static extraction of the size/hash-pinned public Beta16 App; never execute the old App or fetch new model bytes. releaseProductionBoundary.publication: Preserve actor, exact final-main commit, source fingerprint, artifact provenance, checksum and runtime binding protections. Changed or absent evidence must fail closed; no fallback to broad retests, CUDA upload or new inference.
